scope.scope: Post-hoc explanation of already closed fixed MMD sixfold failure; no new fit or method selection
scope.models: All six folds, each initial, validation-selected and final epoch64 saved model; no fold picked from test performance
scope.batch: Exactly each fold's original epoch1 first shuffled training batch64 (seed20261029+1); training IDs and labels only
scope.existing_evidence: All producer step losses, all64 validation curves, original GAP validation curves, training-user/class support and per-source class proportions
scope.gradient_evidence_limit: Original producer logs do not record separate classification/MMD gradients. New read-only offline gradient probes are explicitly post-hoc sampled state probes, not historical per-step gradients or a causal ablation
scope.independent_checks: Native full model forward/head prehook; manual stable BCE; actual pinned DomainBed class AST MMD; independent direct-difference float64 RBF values and analytical gradient; verify original first-step logits/losses/IDs exactly
scope.measure: Component gradient norms overall/backbone/head, gradient cosines, joint clip2 coefficient, diagonal biased-MMD constant, first-batch source/class composition, feature dispersion; no optimizer step or checkpoint writes
scope.immutable: All original scientific files/checkpoints/logs remain byte-identical; live VREx process and frozen protocol untouched
scope.forbidden: No held labels or held predictions loaded, no test score recomputation, no coefficient/kernel/epoch/seed search, no retraining or changing the closed result
scope.interpretation: Reproduction verifies determinism only. Agreement with an independent sampled objective/gradient check narrows particular implementation errors but cannot rule out every shared implementation/protocol error or establish mechanism causally
